nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Ignore rules for the understand-anything knowledge graph tool, listing paths and patterns that should be excluded from analysis (e.g., binary assets, generated files, large data splits).

nodes.name: ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS
nodes.summary: Credits and attribution notice listing third-party libraries, datasets, and prior work that the kvcompression project builds upon.

nodes.name: train.txt
nodes.summary: Training split index file for the RULER benchmark dataset, listing 6175 sample identifiers used to select KV cache training examples for RL agent learning.

nodes.name: val.txt
nodes.summary: Validation split index file for the RULER benchmark dataset, listing 325 sample identifiers used to evaluate RL agent performance during and after training.

nodes.name: preprocess_ruler.yaml
nodes.summary: Configuration for the RULER dataset preprocessing pipeline, specifying the model, tokenizer, data directories, chunking parameters, device settings, and KV cache generation options used to produce training data.

nodes.name: agent_training_setup.sh
nodes.summary: Shell setup script for initializing a single RL agent training job: installs system and Python dependencies via uv, then downloads only the specific layer/head KV cache data needed for training to /dev/shm for fast in-memory access.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses /dev/shm for RAM-backed storage to maximize I/O throughput during training data loading.

nodes.name: preprocessing_setup.sh
nodes.summary: Shell setup script for the KV cache preprocessing stage: validates the KVCOMPRESSION_MODEL_ID environment variable, installs dependencies via uv, and downloads the target LLM from HuggingFace using torchtune.

nodes.name: train_single_head.yaml
nodes.summary: Primary training configuration for a single KV head RL agent, covering all aspects of the training loop: agent architecture, environment parameters, reward strategy, EMA, optimizer, learning rate schedule, logging, WandB integration, profiler, and final evaluation settings.

nodes.name: inference_demo.ipynb
nodes.summary: Jupyter notebook demonstrating end-to-end inference with a trained KV compression agent, walking through model loading, agent application, and evaluation of eviction quality.

nodes.name: download_data.py
nodes.summary: CLI tool for downloading KV cache training data from an S3-compatible remote store; supports selective download by layer, head, and data split, with completeness verification of the downloaded hierarchy.

nodes.name: DataDownloader
nodes.summary: Orchestrates selective AWS S3 data downloads for KV cache training datasets; handles pattern-based inclusion, split-based sample filtering, and hierarchical completeness verification.

nodes.name: agent_registry.py
nodes.summary: CLI commands for discovering and validating trained RL agent checkpoints stored in a remote S3 bucket, providing sweep inventory, per-agent discovery, and completeness validation against expected layer/head counts.

nodes.name: list_sweeps
nodes.summary: Typer CLI command that lists all training sweep names found in the configured S3 bucket group.

nodes.name: discover
nodes.summary: Typer CLI command that discovers all agent checkpoints within a named sweep and prints a summary of what was found.

nodes.name: validate_sweep
nodes.summary: Typer CLI command that validates a completed sweep by checking that all expected (layer, head) agent checkpoints are present and not corrupted, reporting missing or incomplete entries.

nodes.name: assignment_generator.py
nodes.summary: CLI tool that generates composite YAML assignment files for parallel RL agent training jobs, mapping sweep names to specific (layer, head) pairs and validating availability of required checkpoints.

nodes.name: write_composites
nodes.summary: Typer CLI command that writes composite job assignment YAML files for a set of sweep names, layers, and heads; validates agent registry completeness before emitting the assignment files.

nodes.name: cli_logging.py
nodes.summary: Configures Rich-based logging for the kvcompression CLI, providing a custom handler that prints colorized log records to stdout and a setup function that wires it into the root logger.

nodes.name: CLIRichHandler
nodes.summary: Custom logging.Handler subclass that uses a Rich Console to emit formatted log records with color and markup to the terminal.

nodes.name: setup_cli_logging
nodes.summary: Installs the CLIRichHandler on the root logger and sets the logging level, replacing any previously registered handlers.

nodes.name: policy_entropy_loss.py
nodes.summary: Implements the REINFORCE policy gradient loss with entropy regularization for KV cache eviction agents; reconstructs valid action masks from episode history and computes policy and entropy losses over valid episode steps.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses masked Categorical distributions to correctly handle variable-length KV sequences and the progressive shrinking of the valid action set as entries are evicted.

nodes.name: compute_policy_entropy_loss
nodes.summary: Computes the REINFORCE policy gradient loss with entropy bonus by reconstructing per-step action masks from episode trajectories, applying masked Categorical distributions, and returning total, entropy, policy, and average entropy losses.
